text.aria-label: Title text 'Injected drift is seen when the shift in the fitted trend exceeds the interval half-width. Above the dashed line at 1 the injected loss moves the trend by more than the real noise.'
text.tspan: Injected drift is seen when the shift in the fitted trend exceeds the interval half-width.
Above the dashed line at 1 the injected loss moves the trend by more than the real noise.
